reference_output_control.scope: All224 B1 default outputs match their prior full-corpus audit, individually verified by each member.

scope: Four separately successful allocations cover distinct languages; every condition retains its own seven paired repeats in one allocation. No interrupted-job samples reused and no per-condition samples spliced across jobs. Same executable runtime, checkpoint and engines; frontend/cache history and physical GPU allocation can differ across subsets. Per-language RTFx changes compare the two variants within that job, not a global multi-job speedup. Cold/memory/utilization remain per job; repeats are not additional distinct audio inputs.
